a_html:
I offer one-to-one healing sessions and longer-term containers designed to support sustainable change.

I offer weekly online guided meditation sessions and a monthly in-person event called the Moonlight Meditations and Shamanic Circle.

From time to time, I run residential 3-5 day Retreats and Day Workshops.

This work is integrative. I combine nervous system regulation, somatic and embodied practices, subconscious exploration, and shamanic approaches. Each session is guided by what is present for you, rather than a fixed method.

You can work with me through:

  • Individual sessions — for focused support or as a way to begin

  • Ongoing containers — for deeper transformation and integration over time

Many clients start with a single session, and then choose to continue once they experience the work.

If you’re unsure where to begin, you’re welcome to start there. Or reach out on the contact page, and I can help guide you.

q: What's it like to work with you?
a_html:
Collaborative, honest, genuine, authentic, and gentle.

I’m here to guide your process in relation to your goals and needs. We may work with the body, breath, awareness, subconscious patterns, or deeper energetic layers. Some sessions feel grounding and regulating. Others may move into emotional release or insight.

There is no rigid formula — the work meets you where you are.

q: What kinds of issues do you work with?
a_html:
I support clients with:

  • Chronic pain and physical symptoms

  • Stress, anxiety, and nervous system dysregulation

  • Emotional overwhelm or feeling “stuck”

  • Life transitions and identity shifts

  • A desire for deeper connection, meaning, or healing

You don’t need to have a clear “problem” — sometimes the work begins with a feeling that something wants to shift.

a_html:

You are never asked to believe anything, only to explore your own experience.

q: How many sessions will I need?
a_html:
This is different for everyone.

Some people come for a single session to work through something specific. Others choose to work together over time for deeper integration and ongoing support.

We can discuss what feels right for you after your first session.

However it is important to note that any change work, healing and sustainable shift is not something that can happen in one session. So while 1 session may feel nice, I do recommend a commitment to doing the work for a period of time to actually see the sustainable results on your life.

Typically suggestions for quantities of sessions for various modalities to get transformative change are as follows:

-10 sessions of Rebirthing Breathwork, or

-4 sessions of Access Bars, or

-3 months of my Transformational Healing program.

  • Wear something you can be relaxed in

  • Allow yourself a few minutes before to arrive, and after to integrate

Coming exactly as you are is enough.
